Stockfish.js / Stockfish 19.0.1 — browser chess engine

These files are distributed as unmodified, browser-executable engine assets:
- stockfish-19-lite-single.js
- stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm

Engine project and corresponding source:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js

License: GNU General Public License, version 3.
License text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

Stockfish runs inside a local browser Web Worker. The Xi Meng phone's
chess board and story script remain separate from its calculation of moves.
